items.title: test(ui): capture live operator authority in guest question fixture
items.summary: test(ui): capture live operator authority in guest question fixture The guest fixture manually created admitted authority without the live role-assignment reader required by question.request. The request threw before responding, leaving the registration deferred pending until the unchanged UI deadline. Use the existing Gateway authority capture owner and release its lease during fixture cleanup. The original native shard reproduces the failure; the repaired fixture passes 20 standalone runs, three original shards, and authority siblings with unchanged assertions and deadlines.
